summary: Frontend-only test of the POT24 rebrand (mobile 390x844 primary, desktop 1440 for admin). Passing: all brand assets/favicon/manifest/posters return 200; title is 'POT24 — Play Like Royalty'; /welcome has no TIMEUP/PAZER text, shows 'Play like royalty', hero-cta 'Claim your throne' goes to /register, hero-login and footer-cta are present, and the 6 landing-games WebM videos autoplay and loop once scrolled into view. Player login goes to /splash (brand-intro, crown drop, caption 'WELCOME, ROYALTY') and then /home after about 2.7s. nav-logout goes to /bye (brand-outro, 'SEE YOU SOON'), then /welcome with the token cleared; visiting /home afterwards redirects to /login. Hub cards loop sm/*.webm with poster/<id>.jpg. HowToPlay popups appear for all 6 games and their hd videos play after about 1.5s of loading. The friends-demo video plays. The referral share text and the RaceRoom share text (checked in code) say POT24. All 6 games load, their 3D canvases render (not black) and the start buttons are enabled with dark text. /1v1 and /multiplayer list rooms. The admin login page and admin panel are black/gold with no blue. Bug found and fixed: admin login skipped the 'Command Center' splash because of a race with a useEffect redirect. Retested: now /splash?to=admin, then /admin, and admin-logout plays the outro and lands on /admin/login. Remaining issues are 2 white-on-gold contrast problems and leftover red accents.

ui_bugs.issue: FIXED: on successful admin login the useEffect `if (user.role==='admin') nav('/admin')` fired after login() set the user and overrode nav('/splash?to=admin'), so the Command Center intro was skipped. Fixed with a submitting ref guard.

issues: The 'Play with Friends' button (data-testid=open-custom-room) has white text (rgb 255,255,255) on a gold gradient (#f5b301 to #ffc933). Contrast is about 1.8:1, which is unreadable. It uses bg-gradient-to-r from-pazer-red to-pazer-redhover text-white (QuickActions.js:28). Change to dark text, e.g. text-[#170f02].
The active TabsTrigger uses data-[state=active]:text-white on gold (Admin.js:233), so 'Overview' and other active tabs are white on gold with low contrast. Use dark text.

Per-game accent borders and glows are still multi-color. Aviator is red (#ef4444), Tower is green, Vortex is purple. This doesn't match 'accents gold, not red'. Consider gold borders or at least removing the red.
Aviator (red mountains), Tower/stack (red/pink block on a maroon background) and T Mines (maroon tower) still use the old red-neon palette inside the canvases. Optional: retint them gold/warm.
The floating REFER button and win-ticker overlap the bottom of the Aviator and Chicken cards' text and arrow buttons at 390px (layout carried over from before, not new).

action_items: QuickActions.js:28 open-custom-room: replace text-white with dark text (#170f02) on the gold gradient
Admin.js:233: replace data-[state=active]:text-white with dark text on the active gold tab
Optionally switch the hub card accent colors (red Aviator etc.) and the red-tinted 3D scenes to gold
critical_code_review_comments: AdminLogin had an auth-state redirect effect racing with the post-submit navigation (fixed with a ref). Login.js has no such effect, so it is fine.

Internal identifiers still use old names (localStorage pazer_token, 'pazer:popup' events, the bg-pazer-red class, backend logger 'pazer', cloudinary folder 'timeup/'). None of these are user-visible, so this is acceptable.
The referral code prefix is still 'TU' (e.g. TU2124FC). This is user-visible and a leftover from the TIMEUP brand. Consider a 'P24' prefix for new codes.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Rebrand verified. The AdminLogin splash race is fixed with a submitting useRef. HowTo videos take about 1.5s to start (hd webm). Stopwatch rooms on /1v1 and /multiplayer don't use race-card testids. Check contrast of open-custom-room and the admin active tab after the main agent fixes them.
rca of the issue: AdminLogin.js: useEffect([loading,user]) redirects admins to /admin. login() calls setUser and dispatches wallet:refresh, which re-renders the component and runs the effect, overriding nav('/splash?to=admin'). Repro: login on /admin/login and the URL goes straight to /admin. Mitigation: a ref set during submit skips the effect.
